title: Run C — matched social scenarios (ISF 2026 pilot)
text_source: סנריואים/settings_v15_2026-09-30.json (Roy's accepted texts of 30.9 night; second part = Option A parallel stories); freeze pending

design.block_order: traits -> ambiguous block -> clear block -> demographics -> realism -> debrief
design.counterbalancing: half X/Y × order 0-3 (Williams square) × ambPattern 0/1 × levelPattern 0/1 = 32 cells, drawn at random client-side (config.force overrides)
design.mode_default: all16: every participant sees all 16 settings as ambiguous items (8 A + 8 B, half high/half low), then all 16 as clear versions (each version 4 times) using the parallel stories (alt); 8+8 design still available (config allSettings=false or ?full=0)

clear: stressed, appreciated, liked (How much would you feel…, 1-7, Not at all / Very much)
stay: one of three boxes (stay & persist / wait and see / leave)
submission, status enhancement, belittling, approach-invite (reach out and invite), approach-help (do something nice / help) (How likely is it that you would react this way? 1-7)
ambiguous: stressed, appreciated, liked (How much would you feel…, 1-7)

config_keys.endpoint: POST receiver URL (empty = JSON download at the end)
config_keys.timeScale: multiplier for the reading floors (1 = real)
config_keys.minReadSeconds: seconds before Next is enabled on a scenario page (8)

url_parameters.debug=1: exposes window.D; answers optional; enables auto=1, ts=, traits=, half=, order=, amb=, lvl=, full=0|1, seq=1 (fixed order 1-16), altset=story|mild; shows a version banner

measures: amb[16 or 8]: cog[3], block{stress,appreciated,liked}, stay (choice), ms
verification: 30.9.2026 night: all-16 run with all seven questionnaires and 8+8 run, headless, complete, zero console issues; test_runs/v16_*.json
